LESSON: FOODS/FEEDING PRACTICES

Grade: PP1
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: HEALTH
Topic 2.5: Foods/Feeding PRACTICES

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Foods/Feeding PRACTICES. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How do we eat?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. talk about different food eaten at home 131
2. talk about the importance of eating clean food
3. tell the importance of eating food
4. talk about the dangers of sharing food from someone else’s mouth pictures of foods found in the e) feed self-using clean hands or local environment feeding items appropriately f) observe proper feeding habits g) maintaining a clean feeding area h) appreciate different foods eaten at home dangers of eating food from someone’s mouth feeding self about proper feeding habits feeding area songs and recite poems on foods eaten at home and school appropriate cultural feeding habits using clean feeding items feeding habits, cleaning foods (fruits and vegetables,) Core-Competences to be developed: 132

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. talk about different food eaten at home 131
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to talk about different food eaten at home 131. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. talk about the importance of eating clean food
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to talk about the importance of eating clean food. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. tell the importance of eating food
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to tell the importance of eating food. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

4. talk about the dangers of sharing food from someone else’s mouth pictures of foods found in the e) feed self-using clean hands or local environment feeding items appropriately f) observe proper feeding habits g) maintaining a clean feeding area h) appreciate different foods eaten at home dangers of eating food from someone’s mouth feeding self about proper feeding habits feeding area songs and recite poems on foods eaten at home and school appropriate cultural feeding habits using clean feeding items feeding habits, cleaning foods (fruits and vegetables,) Core-Competences to be developed: 132

Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At school, pick litter and put it in the bin. That cares for the environment.

Example 2: Wash your hands with soap before eating and after using the toilet.

Example 3: Name two foods you eat at home that help you grow strong.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.
2. Explain Foods/Feeding PRACTICES to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.
4. Show that you can: talk about different food eaten at home 131
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Foods/Feeding PRACTICES. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: How do we eat?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. talk about different food eaten at home 131
2. talk about the importance of eating clean food
3. tell the importance of eating food
4. talk about the dangers of sharing food from someone else’s mouth pictures of foods found in the e) feed self-using clean hands or local environment feeding items appropriately f) observe proper feeding habits g) maintaining a clean feeding area h) appreciate different foods eaten at home dangers of eating food from someone’s mouth feeding self about proper feeding habits feeding area songs and recite poems on foods eaten at home and school appropriate cultural feeding habits using clean feeding items feeding habits, cleaning foods (fruits and vegetables,) Core-Competences to be developed: 132

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
